dict.把毒雾罐扔到瞄准位置，5 秒内雾里的敌人持续中毒并减速。: Throws a poison canister to the aimed spot; for 5 s enemies in the mist are poisoned and slowed.
dict.隐身 5 秒，移动速度 +25%；隐身时的第一击伤害 +50%（攻击后现形）。: Turn invisible for 5 s with +25% move speed; your first hit while invisible deals +50% (attacking reveals you).
dict.附近敌人（230 范围）的大招充能减少 25%、装填速度 -30%（3 秒），技: Nearby enemies (230 range) lose 25% Super charge, reload 30% slower for 3 s, and their skills are interrupted for 0.6 s.
dict.朝前方扔出闪光弹：扇形范围内的敌人受到 12 点伤害、减速 1.2 秒，并被「致: Throws a flashbang forward: enemies in the cone take 12 damage, are slowed for 1.2 s and are Blinded for 2.5 s — their vision shrinks to a small circle around them.
dict.朝瞄准方向甩出一张封印符，落地展开 2.5 秒符阵：阵里的敌人减速 40%、不能: Throws a seal talisman where you aim. It opens a circle for 2.5 s: enemies inside are slowed by 40% and can't use skills or Supers.
dict.呼叫补给箱砸到瞄准的位置（最远 260）：落地砸中敌人造成 40 点伤害；之后: Calls a supply crate onto the aimed spot (up to 260): it deals 40 damage to enemies it lands on; for 6 s after, allies who reach the crate instantly refill their ammo and get a 30 shield (once each), and reload 30% faster.
dict.瞬间闪到瞄准方向（最远 220），可以穿过墙壁和掩体，闪移瞬间无敌；2 秒内的下: Instantly blinks toward your aim (up to 220), passing through walls and cover, briefly invulnerable; your next attack within 2 s deals +35% damage.
dict.发动时全部敌人沉默 3 秒（不能放技能和大招），并且每人失去 1 次技能充能。: Silences every enemy for 3 s (no skills or Supers), and each loses 1 skill charge.
dict.被电磁脉冲命中的敌人，3 秒内技能充能停止回复。: Enemies hit by the EMP stop regaining skill charges for 3 s.
dict.击毁机体或击倒驾驶员时掉落一个礼盒，第一个碰到的队友获得 40% 大招充能。: Destroying a mech or knocking out a pilot drops a gift box; the first teammate to touch it gains 40% Super charge.
dict.弹药装满时的第一次攻击伤害 +15%；撤离模式中搜索容器的速度 +20%。: Your first attack with full ammo deals +15% damage; in Extraction, you search containers 20% faster.
dict.脉冲让夜鸢无法攻击，后门程序让她的墨雾迟迟充不回来。: The pulse stops Raven from attacking, and Backdoor keeps her ink smoke from recharging.
dict.相位闪移穿墙切到后排，姜黎的雾场跟不上零号。: Phase Blink goes through walls to the backline before Jiang Li’s field can catch Zero.
dict.凌焰冲脸时迎面吃一发闪光弹：减速又看不见，冲锋扑了个空。: Blaze charges straight into a flashbang — slowed and blinded, the charge hits nothing.
dict.补给箱给的护盾正好挡住秦岳的一波爆发。: The supply crate’s shield soaks exactly one burst from Qin Yue.
dict.简易领域自动反击闯入者，零号闪进领域只会撞上符咒斩。: Simple Domain counters intruders automatically — Zero blinking in just meets a talisman slash.
dict.声波干扰打断技能、吸走大招充能，苏糖的应援和大招都慢半拍。: Jamming interrupts skills and drains Super charge, leaving Candy’s Cheer and Super a step behind.
dict.👁 全队视野：所有敌人都暴露了: 👁 Team vision: every enemy is revealed
dict.2.2.1 来啦：被暴露的敌人现在会显示在小地图和大地图上，头顶也有清楚的状态图: Update 2.2.1 is here: revealed enemies now show on the minimap and the full map, with clear status icons over their heads, and characters whose mechanics overlapped now each have their own identity. Please accept this small gift!
dict.近身格斗：冲到敌人脸上打出爆发伤害。: Melee: get in the enemy’s face and burst them down.
dict.中距离连射：火力持续，正面对枪的主力。: Mid-range sustained fire: the backbone of any head-on firefight.
dict.远程点杀：在敌人够不着的距离打出高伤害。: Long-range picks: high damage from where enemies can’t reach you.
dict.投掷 / 曲射 / 穿墙：越过掩体打击躲起来的敌人。: Thrown / lobbed / through walls: hits enemies hiding behind cover.
dict.前排坦克：血厚、减伤，挡在队友前面推进。: Frontline tank: lots of HP and damage reduction, leading the push for the team.
dict.高速切入：绕到后排，秒掉脆皮目标。: Fast divers: flank the backline and delete fragile targets.
dict.治疗、增益、补给：让队友打得更久、更狠。: Healing, buffs and supplies: keep teammates fighting longer and harder.
dict.减速、沉默、束缚：打乱敌人的节奏。: Slows, silences and binds: break the enemy’s rhythm.
dict.强化自己的输出和续航，正面硬打。: Boosts their own damage and sustain to win head-on fights.
dict.视野、机动、隐身：先发现敌人，再决定打不打。: Vision, mobility and stealth: spot the enemy first, then choose the fight.
dict.持续火力最怕的就是低血量的刺客冲进来——压制机体扫一轮就能把它打回去。: Low-HP assassins diving in are exactly what sustained fire punishes — one sweep from a Suppressor sends them back.
dict.狙击蓄力慢、血量低，刺客一个突进贴脸就结束了。: Snipers charge slowly and have little HP — one assassin dash into their face ends it.
dict.重装机体又大又慢，在狙击射程外根本摸不到人，只能一路挨打。: Tanks are big and slow; they can’t reach a sniper outside its range and just keep taking hits.
dict.突击机体的近身爆发打在厚血量和减伤上，打不穿还会被反推。: A brawler’s close-range burst hits thick HP and damage reduction — it can’t break through and gets pushed back.
dict.炮击机体有最小射程、近身很弱，突击冲过炮火就能贴身。: Artillery has a minimum range and is weak up close; brawlers charge through the shells and get in close.
dict.压制机体站桩扫射，炮弹越过掩体落到它头上；射程也更远。: Suppressors stand still to spray; shells arc over cover onto their heads, from further away.
dict.突击型驾驶员要贴脸打输出，减速、沉默和束缚正好打断他们的节奏。: Assault pilots need to get close to deal damage; slows, silences and binds break their rhythm.
dict.支援型驾驶员自保能力弱，强攻一波爆发，回血还没到人就倒了。: Support pilots can’t protect themselves — one all-in burst drops them before the heals land.
dict.侦察靠信息差打零散的消耗，治疗和增益能把这些消耗全部补回来。: Scouts win through information and chip damage; heals and buffs undo all of it.
dict.控制技能都要靠近才能放，侦察先看见他们，保持距离就控不到。: Control skills need to be close; scouts see them coming and stay out of range.
dict.推土机兵又大又慢，在狙击 720 的射程外根本摸不到你。: The Dozer is big and slow and can’t reach you outside the Sniper’s 720 range.
dict.旋转机兵射程只有 380，狙击可以在它够不着的地方点名。: The Gatling’s range is only 380 — the Sniper picks it off from beyond that.
dict.拆楼锤必须贴脸，还没走到就被狙掉一大截血。: The Wrecker has to get close and loses a big chunk of HP to the Sniper on the way.
dict.喷火罐车射程短，战术步枪 430 的射程可以一直放风筝。: The Flamer is short-ranged; the Tactical rifle’s 430 range kites it all day.
dict.侦察无人机能把隐身的幻影照出来。: The recon drone exposes an invisible Phantom.
dict.战术步枪射程更远，站在结界外面就能点射。: The Tactical rifle outranges it and can fire from outside the barrier.
dict.狙击蓄力时移动慢、血量低，影刃一个突进就能贴脸。: The Sniper moves slowly while charging and has low HP — one Blade dash closes the gap.
dict.迫击炮有最小射程，影刃贴身后它几乎打不到。: The Mortar has a minimum range and can barely hit the Blade once it’s close.
dict.母舰近身没有自保能力，影刃一贴身就很危险。: The Carrier can’t defend itself up close — once the Blade is on it, it’s in trouble.
dict.棱镜原型机血量低、要蓄力，被影刃贴身就输了。: The Prism Prototype has low HP and needs to charge; once the Blade gets close, it’s over.
dict.隐身摸到弹弓机兵身边，弹跳炮弹来不及调头。: Sneaks up on the Slinger invisibly before its bouncing shells can turn around.
dict.隐身绕到狙击身后，伏击一击就能打掉大半管血。: Circles behind the Sniper while invisible; one ambush hit takes most of its HP.
dict.隐身绕到母舰身后，追踪弹来不及转向。: Circles behind the Carrier while invisible, faster than its homing shots can turn.
dict.毒针射程 400，重拳只能近身，一路被毒着靠近。: The Stinger has 400 range; the Fist can only fight up close and gets poisoned all the way in.
dict.拆楼锤要贴脸才能打人，毒针边退边射，减速让它追不上。: The Wrecker must get close; the Stinger backs off while shooting and the slow keeps it from catching up.
dict.喇叭车血量不高、攻速慢，毒针持续消耗很快就能磨死它。: The Megaphone has modest HP and attacks slowly — the Stinger’s steady poke wears it down fast.
dict.持续扫射对低血量的影刃非常致命，它突进过来就被扫掉。: Sustained spray is deadly to the low-HP Blade — it gets mowed down as it dashes in.
dict.旋转机兵火力更持续，毒针在正面对枪里拼不过。: The Gatling’s fire is more sustained; the Stinger loses a head-on shootout.
dict.滚刷冲锋的路上就被扫掉一半血。: The Roller loses half its HP charging in.
dict.枪骑突刺进来要先吃满一轮扫射，血量撑不住。: The Lancer has to eat a full spray on the way in and doesn’t have the HP for it.
dict.火焰覆盖面极大，隐身的幻影也会被烧出来。: Flames cover a huge area — even an invisible Phantom gets burned out.
dict.近身喷火 + 点燃，影刃切进来就变成火球。: Close-range fire plus burning: the Blade turns into a fireball as it dives in.
dict.无人机弹打不准也能命中，毒针机兵血量低扛不住。: Drone shots hit even without aiming, and the low-HP Stinger can’t take it.
dict.无人机射程 500，比迫击炮的 420 更远，还会自动追踪。: Drones reach 500 — further than the Mortar’s 420 — and home in automatically.
dict.喷罐中距离连射，滚刷冲过来之前就被打掉一截。: The Blaster’s mid-range bursts chip the Roller before it arrives.
dict.弹弓机兵近身很弱，喷罐的中距离连射正好克它。: The Slinger is weak up close, and the Blaster’s mid-range bursts punish it.
dict.符印束缚 + 减速，影刃切进来就走不掉。: Seal binds and slows mean the Blade can’t get out once it dives in.
dict.减速光弹让重拳很难贴身。: Slowing shots make it hard for the Fist to get close.
dict.结界里队友减伤回血，灵刃的爆发打不穿。: Allies inside the barrier take less damage and heal; the Reaper’s burst can’t break through.
dict.炮弹越过掩体，砸在站桩扫射的旋转机兵头上。: Shells arc over cover onto the Gatling as it stands still spraying.
dict.炮弹从天上落下，防暴盾牌的正面护盾挡不住。: Shells fall from above where the riot shield can’t block them.
dict.炮弹射程 420，喷火罐车靠不过来。: With 420 range, the Mortar keeps the Flamer from getting close.
dict.光束需要直线视野，迫击炮躲在掩体后照样能轰它。: The beam needs line of sight, while the Mortar can shell it from behind cover.
dict.弹跳炮弹越过盾牌，落到盾卫身后爆炸。: Bouncing shells hop over the shield and explode behind the Riot.
dict.推土机兵太慢，弹跳炮弹两次爆炸都能命中。: The Dozer is too slow to dodge either blast of a bouncing shell.
dict.弹跳炮弹越过结界边缘，直接落进结界里。: Bouncing shells clear the barrier’s edge and land right inside.
dict.音波穿过盾牌和墙壁，正面护盾没用。: Sound waves pass through shields and walls; the front shield does nothing.
dict.被音波打中会暴露位置，幻影隐身打一下就现形。: Sound waves reveal what they hit, so one hit exposes the invisible Phantom.
dict.狙击躲在掩体后面也会被穿墙音波打到。: Snipers hiding behind cover still get hit by sound waves through the wall.
dict.正面护盾挡掉近一半喷罐弹，近距离电击反打。: The front shield blocks almost half of the Blaster’s shots, and the baton shocks back up close.
dict.盾墙挡住所有追踪弹。: The shield wall blocks every homing shot.
dict.正面突刺全部扎在盾牌上，伤害大减。: Frontal thrusts all land on the shield and lose most of their damage.
dict.推土铲把滚刷推开，近距离谁也冲不过推土机兵。: The blade shoves the Roller back — no one out-pushes the Dozer up close.
dict.血量厚、推得远，泼桶的近身爆发打不死它。: Thick HP and strong knockback: the Bucket’s close-range burst can’t finish it.
dict.推土机兵把灵刃推出近战范围，刀气也磨不动它。: The Dozer pushes the Reaper out of melee range, and sword waves barely scratch it.
dict.大锤横扫一大片，影刃切进来就被砸飞。: The hammer sweeps a wide arc — the Blade gets smashed away as it dives in.
dict.拆楼锤攻击范围更大、血更厚，近身互殴更占优。: The Wrecker has more reach and more HP, so it wins the brawl.
dict.大锤一锤 88 伤害还带震荡，泼桶近身打不过。: Each swing does 88 damage and staggers; the Bucket loses up close.
dict.大锤横扫的范围比长枪突刺更宽，枪骑很难躲开。: The hammer’s sweep is wider than a lance thrust, so the Lancer struggles to dodge it.
dict.重拳移动最快，冲到迫击炮脸上它就没办法了。: The Fist is the fastest mech; once it’s in the Mortar’s face, the Mortar has no answer.
dict.弹弓机兵近身很弱，被重拳贴上就跑不掉。: The Slinger is weak up close and can’t escape once the Fist is on it.
dict.滚刷冲锋冲过炮火，贴身碾压。: The Roller charges through the shells and flattens it up close.
dict.甩刷 + 冲锋，近距离一套带走战术机兵。: Flick plus charge takes out the Tactical up close in one combo.
dict.近距离泼桶的伤害远超喷罐。: Up close, the Bucket far outdamages the Blaster.
dict.泼桶近身一大片涂料，灵刃贴上来反而吃满伤害。: The Bucket’s wide splash means a Reaper that gets close takes the full blast.
dict.刀气 230 压制慢吞吞的旋转机兵，回旋斩一套带走。: 230-range sword waves pressure the slow Gatling, and the spin slash finishes it.
dict.喇叭车血量低攻速慢，灵刃冲上去很快就能解决。: The Megaphone has low HP and attacks slowly — the Reaper finishes it quickly.
dict.刀气能打到中距离的毒针，毒针血量低扛不住。: Sword waves reach the mid-range Stinger, which doesn’t have the HP to last.
dict.光束减速让重拳很难贴身，相位冻结直接把它定住。: Beam slows keep the Fist from closing in, and Phase Freeze pins it in place.
dict.相位冻结把推土机兵定在原地挨打。: Phase Freeze locks the Dozer in place to take hits.
dict.拆楼锤必须贴脸，被光束减速 + 冻结后根本靠不过来。: The Wrecker must get close, and with beam slows and freezes it never makes it.
dict.突刺距离长，一下就能刺到狙击脸上。: The thrust has long reach and gets to the Sniper in one move.
dict.同门对决：枪骑的突刺比光束蓄力更快。: Sibling rivalry: the Lancer’s thrust is faster than the beam’s charge.
dict.先手突刺 + 三段突袭，战术机兵的点射来不及打完一轮。: Opening Thrust plus Triple Assault lands before the Tactical finishes a burst.
dict.电磁脉冲 + 远距离草丛侦测，夜鸢的墨雾和草丛藏不住。: EMP plus long-range bush detection: Raven can’t hide in ink smoke or bushes.
dict.脉冲减速让风羽的速度优势没了，冲进来也逃不掉。: The pulse slow takes away Gale’s speed — once she dives in, she can’t get out.
dict.义眼扫描让全队看到隐身和草丛里的夜鸢。: Bionic Scan shows the whole team an invisible or bush-hidden Raven.
dict.远距精准，雷豹靠近之前护盾就被点掉了。: Long-range precision strips Titan’s shield before he gets close.
dict.义眼扫描看穿卡卡的隐身和替身把戏。: Bionic Scan sees through Kaka’s invisibility and decoy tricks.
dict.战场感知自动暴露附近隐身的敌人，夜鸢的墨雾失效。: Battle Sense reveals nearby invisible enemies, making Raven’s ink smoke useless.
dict.隐身的卡卡一靠近就被零号看穿。: An invisible Kaka is spotted the moment he gets close to Zero.
dict.相位突进切到后排，姜黎的雾场跟不上零号的速度。: Phase Rush reaches the backline before Jiang Li’s nano field can catch Zero.
dict.墨雾隐身绕后，先切掉没有自保能力的苏糖。: Ink smoke lets Raven flank and take out Candy, who can’t defend herself.
dict.隐身摸过炮台，直接找星澜本人。: Slips past the turret invisibly and goes straight for Aurora.
dict.小柚的无人机找不到隐身的夜鸢。: Yuzu’s drones can’t find an invisible Raven.
dict.冲刺无敌贴脸，狙击手跟不上风羽的速度。: An invulnerable dash into the sniper’s face — Frost can’t keep up with Gale.
dict.高机动躲开秦岳的手雷和自爆。: High mobility dodges Qin Yue’s grenades and self-destruct.
dict.炮台不会动，风羽绕开炮台直接切星澜。: The turret can’t move, so Gale goes around it and dives Aurora.
dict.肾上腺素冲脸，击杀回血让他越打越凶。: Adrenaline into her face, and kill heals keep Blaze going.
dict.强攻节奏下，大福的便当还没放下人就倒了。: Against all-in pressure, Bao Dafu’s teammates fall before the bento is down.
dict.凌焰不靠技能吃饭，声波干扰对他影响很小，冲脸就赢。: Blaze doesn’t rely on his skill, so jamming barely affects him — he just charges in and wins.
dict.钢铁护盾挡住凌焰的爆发，近身互殴打不过雷豹。: Steel Shield soaks Blaze’s burst; he loses the brawl to Titan.
dict.护盾 + 高生命，赤镰的吸血吸不动。: Shield plus high HP: Aka’s lifesteal can’t keep up.
dict.零号的突刺被护盾吸收，贴身后反被雷豹碾压。: Zero’s thrusts get absorbed by the shield, and up close Titan flattens her.
dict.火力全开 + 自爆，硬碰硬时秦岳的爆发能打穿护盾。: Full Firepower plus self-destruct: in a straight fight Qin Yue’s burst breaks the shield.
dict.手雷越过墙壁，炸散聚在一起的旗手队伍。: Grenades fly over walls and scatter Flag’s clustered team.
dict.手雷越过墙壁，炸到躲在后面放无人机的小柚。: Grenades fly over walls and hit Yuzu hiding behind them with her drones.
dict.定向爆破专炸抱团的队伍，岚的「众志成城」一炸就散。: Demolition Charge punishes clustered teams — one blast breaks Lan’s “United We Stand”.
dict.纳米雾场里的队友扎堆，炸药包正好一锅端。: Allies bunch up in the nano field — perfect for one demolition charge.
dict.恶灵吸血持续作战，大福的回血跟不上赤镰的伤害。: Lifesteal keeps Aka fighting; Bao Dafu’s healing can’t keep up with the damage.
dict.附身吸血 + 减伤，霍克的补给箱拼不过赤镰的续航。: Possession lifesteal and damage reduction outlast Hawk’s supply crate.
dict.附身减伤硬吃脉冲，贴脸收掉脆皮的洛奇。: Possession’s damage reduction tanks the pulse; Aka gets in and finishes the fragile Loki.
dict.应援音波一口回 50，秦岳的爆发打不死人。: Cheer heals 50 at once, so Qin Yue’s burst can’t finish anyone.
dict.炸药炸完，苏糖一个应援全队回满。: After the blast, one Cheer from Candy tops the whole team back up.
dict.便当回血 90，白夜一枪打掉的血很快就补回来了。: A bento heals 90 — Frost’s shot is undone in no time.
dict.零号突刺后打不死人，大福的回血让队友站得住。: Zero can’t finish targets after diving, and Bao Dafu’s heals keep them standing.
dict.声波干扰削弱的是技能和大招，已经放好的便当照样能回满。: Jamming weakens skills and Supers, but a bento already on the ground still heals fully.
dict.集结号让全队伤害 + 移速，凌焰单打独斗打不过一支旗手队。: Rally gives the whole team damage and speed — Blaze alone can’t beat Flag’s squad.

dict.朝瞄准方向高速突进，突进瞬间无敌；2 秒内的下一次攻击伤害 +35%，并暴露突进: Dashes toward your aim, briefly invulnerable; your next attack within 2 s deals +35% damage, and enemies within 260 ahead are revealed for 3 s.
dict.灰石研究园区叛逃博士: Defector from the Grayco Research Park

After Han Bing defected, she sent her a file — and Jiang Li learned her invention was being used to whitewash the whole city. She wiped every server and left with nothing but a prototype.
dict.附近 240 范围内的队友每秒回复 12 生命、受到的伤害 -15%；范围内的敌: Allies within 240 heal 12 HP/s and take 15% less damage; enemies in range are slowed 25%.
dict.打出减速试剂弹，命中的敌人减速 0.6 秒。: Fires slowing reagent rounds; enemies hit are slowed for 0.6 s.
dict.灰石试验部队王牌: Ace of the Grayco Test Unit

dict.编号零，任务变更：保护这座城。: Unit Zero. Mission change: protect this city.
dict.灰石集团试验部队的头号测试驾驶员，代号「零号」，在研究园区的训练舱里长大。姜黎叛: Grayco’s top test pilot, codename “Zero”, raised in the research park’s training pods. The night Jiang Li defected, she was ordered to hunt her down — and chasing her to the city wall, she saw it covered in graffiti and learned for the first time what color the city used to be. That night, she switched off her own tracker.
dict.移动速度 +30%，攻击速度 +25%；击毁机体或击倒驾驶员时立刻回复 1 次技: +30% move speed, +25% attack speed; each mech destroyed or pilot knocked out instantly restores 1 skill charge.
dict.近身快速突刺，向前冲得很远。: A fast close-range stab that lunges far forward.
dict.移动速度 +45%，立刻刷新技能冷却并回复 1 次技能充能。: +45% move speed; instantly resets the skill cooldown and restores 1 skill charge.

dict.研究园区里有人在给我们发加密信号……先打几场，别让灰石起疑。: Someone in the research park is sending us encrypted signals… play a few matches first so Grayco doesn’t get suspicious.
dict.我是园区的研究员姜黎。服务器里有你们需要的东西——来禁区找我。: I’m Jiang Li, a researcher at the park. The servers hold something you need — find me in the Restricted Zone.
dict.园区外围的巡逻机兵变多了。清出一条路来。: More patrol bots are guarding the park’s perimeter. Clear a path.

dict.相位技术本来是用来把涂料「冻住」的。现在，我们反过来用它——把灰墙涂回来。: Phase tech was built to “freeze” paint. Now we turn it around — and paint the grey walls back.
dict.棱镜阵列还缺几个零件。禁区里的研究所应该还有存货。: The prism array is still missing parts. The labs in the Zone should have some left.
dict.我加入你们。从今天起，我的研究只为这座城。: I’m joining you. From today, my research is for this city alone.

dict.灰石派出了试验部队来抓我……带队的是零号。我见过她的训练数据——她从来没输过。: Grayco sent the test unit after me… led by Zero. I’ve seen her training data — she has never lost.
dict.编号零。交出姜黎，否则这座城会被刷成灰色。: Unit Zero. Hand over Jiang Li, or this city gets painted grey.

dict.……城墙上的那些画，是你们涂的？: …Those paintings on the city wall — you made them?
dict.她在禁区里找一样东西：试验部队的真实档案。我们帮她找到。: She’s looking for something in the Zone: the test unit’s real files. Let’s help her find them.
dict.我关掉了追踪器。告诉我——这座城本来是什么颜色？: I switched off my tracker. Tell me — what color was this city before?

dict.原地留下一个替身，2.5 秒后炸开造成 55 点伤害并减速；自己隐身 2.5 秒: Leave a decoy that explodes after 2.5 s for 55 damage and a slow; you turn invisible for 2.5 s with +25% move speed.

dict.超大地图上搜刮物资、和其他小队争夺，在撤离点读条 10 秒成功撤离，带出来的物资: Loot a giant map and fight other squads for supplies. Hold an extraction point for 10 seconds to escape and your loot goes to your warehouse. One life only: die or miss extraction and you lose everything you found this run.
dict.超大地图：集装箱迷宫和废弃仓库，中央的货轮甲板上有金色物资，但有守卫看守。: Giant map: a maze of containers and abandoned warehouses. Legendary loot sits on the cargo ship deck in the middle, but guards watch over it.
dict.超大地图：一间间实验室和走廊，中央反应堆大厅藏着最值钱的东西，守卫重重。: Giant map: labs and corridors everywhere. The reactor hall in the middle hides the most valuable loot, heavily guarded.
dict.两张超大地图随机选一张: One of the two giant maps at random
dict.阵亡只丢这局搜到的物资: Dying only loses what you found this run
dict.物资更多、品质更高，可以带装备进场，但阵亡时装备也会丢: More and better loot, and you can bring gear, but you lose that gear if you die
dict.生命低于 30% 时自动回复 60 生命（一次）: Heals 60 HP once when you drop below 30% HP
dict.装备只能带进高危行动: Gear can only be brought into High-Risk Runs
dict.高危行动阵亡时，带入的装备会丢失: In a High-Risk Run you lose your gear if you die
dict.只有房主可以开始行动: Only the host can start the run
dict.仓库还是空的。去「搜刮撤离」带点东西回来吧！: Your warehouse is empty. Go bring something back from Extraction!
dict.撤离带出的物资都在这里：卖掉换金币、传说物资兑换宝石和能量结晶；军需处买高危行动: Everything you extract ends up here: sell it for coins or trade legendary items for gems and power crystals. Buy gear for High-Risk Runs at the Quartermaster
dict.史诗和传说物资不会被一键卖出: Epic and Legendary items are never bulk-sold
dict.装备只能带进「高危行动」：成功撤离会保留，阵亡就会丢失。在搜刮撤离界面选择要带的: Gear can only be brought into High-Risk Runs: keep it if you extract, lose it if you die. Choose your gear on the Extraction screen.
dict.撤离中…离开圈子或挨打会中断: Extracting… leaving the circle or taking damage interrupts it
dict.成 功 撤 离 ！: E X T R A C T E D !
dict.撤 离 失 败: E X T R A C T I O N   F A I L E D
dict.阵亡或没来得及撤离：这局搜到的物资全部丢失: Died or didn't extract in time: everything found this run is lost
dict.下次记得早点去撤离点: Head to an extraction point earlier next time
dict.选择左边的邮件查看: Pick a mail on the left to read it
dict.每完成一个就能领一次奖励: Claim a reward for each one you finish
dict.灰城外围发现了大量废弃物资！进入超大地图搜刮、和其他小队争夺，活着撤离才算数。: Tons of abandoned supplies were found outside Gray City! Loot the giant maps, fight other squads, and only what you get out alive counts.
dict.以自己为中心展开 6 秒的半透明结界：里面的队友受到的伤害 -30%、每秒回复: Raises a barrier around you for 6 s: allies inside take 30% less damage and heal 10 HP per second, and enemies inside are slowed by 25%.
dict.蓄力 0.35 秒，朝瞄准方向斩出一道巨大的灵能刀气：贯穿 520 距离内的所有: Charges for 0.35 s, then sends a huge spirit wave where you aim: it pierces every enemy within 520, dealing 85 damage with knockback and painting the whole path.
dict.朝瞄准方向甩出一张封印符，落地展开 2.5 秒符阵：阵里的敌人减速 40%、不能: Throws a seal talisman where you aim. It opens a circle for 2.5 s: enemies inside are slowed by 40%, can't use skills or supers, and are revealed.
dict.4 秒内攻击吸血 35%，移动速度 +20%，受到的伤害 -15%。: For 4 s your attacks heal you for 35% of the damage dealt, you move 20% faster and take 15% less damage.
dict.每秒向四周放出一圈符咒：200 范围内的敌人受到 14 点伤害并减速 1 秒；自: Every second, releases a ring of talismans: enemies within 200 take 14 damage and are slowed for 1 s. Your damage +15%.
dict.伤害 +35%，受到的伤害 -20%，每次命中回复 6 生命。: Damage +35%, damage taken -20%, and every hit heals you for 6 HP.
dict.一次甩出 2 张符纸，命中的敌人减速 0.5 秒。: Throws 2 talismans at once; enemies hit are slowed for 0.5 s.
dict.近身横扫一大片，刃口比别的近战武器更宽。: A wide close-range sweep, broader than other melee sidearms.
dict.一张符，镇一方。: One talisman holds the whole street.
dict.夜都术师学院最年轻的符术讲师，袖子里永远藏着几百张亲手写的符。她能用一张纸符封住: The youngest talisman lecturer at the Night City Sorcery Academy, with hundreds of hand-written talismans tucked in her sleeves. She can seal off a whole street with one slip of paper, yet always forgets her umbrella.
dict.别靠太近……它会饿。: Don't get too close... it gets hungry.
dict.在废弃地铁站里误吞了一枚封着恶灵的符核，从此影子会自己动，镰刃上的红光也越来越亮: He swallowed a talisman core with a wraith sealed inside in an abandoned subway station. Since then his shadow moves on its own and the red glow on his sickle grows brighter. The academy sent him to the front line before the wraith wakes up.
dict.最多 4 人合作讨伐巨型咒灵「百目」：它会砸地、放弹幕、召唤小咒灵、冲撞，血量过: Team up (up to 4 players) to bring down the giant curse spirit Hundred-Eyes. It slams the ground, fires bullet rings, summons minions and charges, and it enrages below half HP. Defeat it within 4 minutes to win!
dict.打倒四处游荡的咒灵会掉落封印石，地图上也会不时出现。把封印石带回己方祭坛存起来，: Wandering curse spirits drop seal stones when defeated, and more stones appear on the map. Bring them back to your altar; if you're knocked out you drop everything you carry. First team to bank 25 wins!
dict.深夜的夜都十字路口：四栋高楼夹着空旷的路口，两侧有天桥和神社石台，翻倒的车辆是最: A Night City crossroads at midnight: four towers surround an open intersection, with overpasses and shrine platforms on both sides and overturned cars for cover.
dict.午夜的夜都，咒灵从地铁站里涌了出来！玩限时玩法「咒灵讨伐」「封印争夺」赚取灵符：: At midnight, curse spirits pour out of the Night City subway! Play the limited modes Curse Raid and Seal Clash to earn Talismans. Complete quests to get the new pilot Sigil and the Warden mech for free, and trade for collab skins in the event shop. Every Raid or Seal Clash match gives extra Talismans, and other modes give a few.
dict.午夜的夜都，咒灵从地铁站里涌了出来！联动活动「夜都决战」开幕：新驾驶员符零和赤镰: At midnight, curse spirits pour out of the Night City subway! The collab event Night City Showdown has begun: new pilots Sigil and Crimson, the Warden and Spiritblade mechs, and the limited modes Curse Raid and Seal Clash are all live. Take these Talismans and check out the collab skins in the event shop!
dict.今天已经领过了，明天再来: Already claimed today, come back tomorrow
dict.联动角色：完成「活动 → 夜都决战」的任务免费获得: Collab character: free from the Night City Showdown event quests
dict.联动角色：在「活动 → 夜都决战」用宝石购买: Collab character: buy with gems in the Night City Showdown event
dict.完成上面的任务免费获得符零和结界机兵；赤镰和灵刃机兵用宝石购买: Get Sigil and the Warden for free from the quests above; Crimson and the Spiritblade are bought with gems
dict.⚠ 快离开红圈！: ⚠ Get out of the red circle!
dict.你的浏览器不支持 WebGL，无法播放 3D 动画: Your browser doesn't support WebGL, so the 3D trailer can't play
dict.帧率上限（电脑发热 / 卡顿时调低）: Frame rate cap (lower it if your computer gets hot or laggy)
dict.暂时没有新的好友申请。朋友输入你的好友码后，申请会出现在这里。: No new friend requests. When a friend enters your friend code, their request shows up here.
dict.对方在线 • 等待通过: Online · waiting for them to accept
dict.有一个好友申请没有通过: One of your friend requests was declined
dict.对局会为你保留 60 秒，期间 AI 暂时帮你操作: Your spot is held for 60 s and an AI plays for you meanwhile
dict.断线时间太长，已退出房间: Disconnected too long, you left the room
dict.与房主的连接断开，正在重连…: Lost connection to the host, reconnecting…
dict.连不上房主了，已回到单机模式: Couldn't reach the host, back to offline mode
dict.好友系统和组队开黑上线了！把你的好友码发给朋友，拉上他们一起打——所有模式都能组: Friends and parties are here! Share your friend code and squad up with your friends. Every mode supports parties, Ranked included, and AI teammates fill any empty slots.
dict.全新玩法「搜刮撤离」上线！进入两张超大地图搜刮物资、和其他小队争夺，活着撤离就能: The new Extraction mode is live! Loot two giant maps, fight other squads, and get out alive to bring your loot back to the warehouse. Here's a little something to try your luck in a High-Risk Run!
dict.把好友码发给朋友，加好友之后可以随时邀请一起开黑——任何模式都可以组队，剩下的位: Send your friend code to friends. Once you're friends you can invite them anytime: every mode supports parties, and AI fills the empty slots
dict.把好友码发给朋友，对方在这里输入就能加你: Give this code to a friend; they enter it here to add you
dict.还没有好友。把你的好友码发给朋友，或者输入朋友的好友码！: No friends yet. Send your friend code to a friend, or enter theirs!
dict.下载版 / 官网：好友之间通过网络直连，双方都需要打开游戏并联网。: Downloaded / website version: friends connect directly, so both of you need the game open and online.
dict.已连接服务器：好友在同一个服务器上就能互相邀请。: Connected to a server: friends on the same server can invite each other.
dict.没有好友在线也没关系——点「对战」就会和 AI 队友一起单排。: No friends online? No problem: hit Battle to play solo with AI teammates.
dict.好友码是 6 位字母和数字: Friend codes are 6 letters and numbers
dict.好友最多 50 个: You can have up to 50 friends
dict.好友申请已发出（对方在线时会收到；不在线的话，等对方上线后会自动再发）: Friend request sent (they get it if online; otherwise it's resent automatically when they come online)
dict.只有队长可以邀请: Only the party leader can invite
dict.等队长开始: Waiting for the leader to start
dict.你的驾驶员 / 机体被禁用了，已自动换成别的: Your pilot / mech was banned, so it was switched automatically
dict.你被请出了队伍: You were removed from the party
dict.好友现在不在线: Your friend is offline right now
